title: Design the project's pruned-root composer: from the three IPSW images (via IOS-004/005) to one image of at most ~2.5 GB that the payload kernel can mount from RAM with a writable RAM overlay and no Android partition: closure of Mach-O dependencies from /sbin/launchd and the job set, hard-link/cryptex-graft handling, pre-seeded data volume (no first-boot migration), output format the in-kernel APFS driver can mount read-only (or an alternative), size and delivery-time budget against the 83 s loader watchdog. Host prototype that writes a manifest only; the image writer comes after the format decision.
acceptance: root_plan.py computes, from the IOS-005 reader, the dynamic-library closure of launchd and of the minimal service set from LC_LOAD_DYLIB and the shared cache's own image list, and writes a manifest (path, size, source image, origin, hash) with the total uncompressed and best-estimate compressed size; tests use synthetic Mach-O headers built from the public format, and the real closure is checked against the real images.

A design note states which output format the kernel mounts (APFS written by a project tool, a different read-only filesystem the kernel already has, or an HFS+ variant) with the evidence for each option's driver state from IOS-003 R02/R03, and the RAM and USB budget against NAT-071/NAT-073.
It lists what is not yet decided and which observation (not a guess) decides it.
steps: Budget against watchdog and USB rate
